There seem to be some areas you haven't\nchecked yet...\nLet's explore the surroundings!
Uh, we're here!
So this is the entrance to the "Ocean Pantry"?\nNo kidding, with a current this strong, we really\nwould've ended up drowning for sure.
Alright! Time to feast my eyes on the treasure~!
Found a potential treasure!\nLet's see what we've got here~!
Huh?\nWhat are these?
I found these glass beads on the seabed.\nUh, humans dropped them, and I thought maybe if\nI picked all of them up, we could be frenz…
Hmm, I don't need these glass beads~.
That's right!\nJust leave that worthless stuff!
Huh?\nDid you say something?
Welp, even if we keep searching, I don't think\nwe'll find anything else here.\nLet's move on to the next area!
Alright, here we go again! I've got a good feeling\nabout this one! Woohoo! Come on, let there be\nsome treasure this time~!
Huh?\nWhat are these?
Uh, they're bottles, each with a letter inside.\nHumans tossed them into the sea, and I picked\nthem up.
I thought maybe if I wrote back to them, we could\nbecome frenz. But I don't understand human writing\nyet. I'm still learning.
You want to reply to all these letters?\nThere are so many! You should learn how to read\nfirst!
Writing letters to humans~?!\nThat's ridiculous! Lemme just throw all of them\naway later!
Huh?\nWhat's wrong?
Hmm, exchanging letters isn't really my thing,\nso this doesn't really count as treasure for me~.\nLet's move on to the next area!
Alright, here we go once again!\nPlease let it be real treasure this time~!
Wow!\nPelulu is really serious about making frenz!
...I think there's a misunderstanding here, but\nit's a hassle to explain. Lemme just go find my\ntreasure first!
Oh my! Who drew this?!\nWhat a lovely shark family! It's beautiful!\nNow this is what I call a real treasure!
Ugh, glass beads again~!
Uh, they're great for making frenz!
Oh! I can really feel the kindness of the little\nshark girl who drew this! Since it's a drawing of\nher father, it hits me even harder!
How about cowrals? I've got some if you want!
I wouldn't get my hopes up about your corals~.
Boohoo, I feel like my heart is weeping~!\nI swear I'll make you understand my feelings~!
You've been so annoying for a while now!\nI'm already so frustrated because I can't find any\ntreasure, so just be quiet!
I won't give up!\nTake me to the next treasure!
